changes.name: SkyboundPetBoostsFixed
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")

local boosts={
 ["Cloud Bunny"]=1.25,
 ["Sky Fox"]=1.5,
 ["Sun Cub"]=2,
 ["Storm Dragon"]=3
}

local function getBoost(player)
 local pet=workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name.."_Pet")
 if not pet then return 1 end
 local gui=pet:FindFirstChildOfClass("BillboardGui")
 local label=gui and gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
 return (label and boosts[label.Text]) or 1
end

local function hookCoin(coin)
 if coin:GetAttribute("PetBoostHooked") then return end
 coin:SetAttribute("PetBoostHooked",true)
 coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
  if not player then return end
  local boost=getBoost(player)
  if boost<=1 then return end
  local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
  local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
  if not coins then return end

  local extra=0
  if boost==1.25 then
   local progress=(player:GetAttribute("CloudBunnyBonus") or 0)+0.25
   if progress>=1 then extra=1 progress-=1 end
   player:SetAttribute("CloudBunnyBonus",progress)
  elseif boost==1.5 then
   local progress=(player:GetAttribute("SkyFoxBonus") or 0)+0.5
   if progress>=1 then extra=1 progress-=1 end
   player:SetAttribute("SkyFoxBonus",progress)
  else
   extra=boost-1
  end
  coins.Value+=extra
 end)
end

local function scan()
 for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
  if obj:IsA("BasePart") and string.match(obj.Name,"^SkyCoin%d+$") then hookCoin(obj) end
 end
end

scan()
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
 if obj:IsA("BasePart") and string.match(obj.Name,"^SkyCoin%d+$") then task.defer(hookCoin,obj) end
end)

print("Skybound pet coin boosts fixed")
